shots.what_changes: The central droplet merges with neighbors, breaks loose, and carves a clear running trail through the condensation.

description.text: Night presses close against a bus window whose glass fills nearly the whole frame. Raindrops sit beaded and trembling across the pane, each one holding a tiny bent highlight, while beyond the glass the city smears into soft streaks of amber streetlight and smudged neon that waver with every shift of water. The dark edge of the bus interior falls away at the borders of the pane, a faint charcoal band against the wet, luminous surface. Droplets gather along the upper glass, hesitate in clustered knots, then begin to slide in thin, uneven tracks, dragging the reflected lights into longer, wobbling threads behind them. Condensation clouds the cooler corners, and fresh beads keep arriving to replace the ones that slip away. The rhythm is slow and steady, water winning ground one narrow channel at a time.
Beaded raindrops cover the night bus window, with blurred streetlights and neon smeared behind the glass.
Soft rain patters against the glass over a low, steady bus engine hum.
Clustered droplets gather, hesitate, then slide downward in thin tracks, stretching the reflected lights.
The camera holds a static shot.

The same wet pane, now seen much closer. A single large droplet trembles at the center of the glass, its surface bowed and glossy, drawing in the smaller beads around it until it swells heavy and round. It breaks free and runs downward in a wavering line, clearing a narrow, glass-clear path through the fogged condensation and leaving a fine wet seam behind. A washed-out streetlight reflection behind the window stretches and thins as the drop passes over it, brightening, then dimming again. Finer droplets continue to creep and merge along the edges of the trail, and a few smaller runnels branch off and stall. The glass stays dark and cool, the city beyond reduced to slow, dissolving color.
Delicate ticking of droplets on glass with a muted engine rumble underneath.
A single large droplet trembles at the center of the condensation-covered pane.
The central droplet breaks loose and runs downward, carving a clear path and stretching the streetlight reflection.
The camera holds a static shot.
